verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents official Track/Pipelines APIs and SDKs for ingesting data, backed by a Postman collection and machine-readable OpenAPI spec (docs-3, docs-6, docs-7, docs-8, probe-2), which supports building AI-native/agentic integrations. However, there's no explicit enumeration of language-specific SDKs (e.g., Node, Python, Java) or independent developer corroboration of SDK quality/completeness beyond one community complaint about lack of code-based flexibility (comm-3). Missing for 10: named list of official SDK languages/repos, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usability, and versioning/maintenance details.
